reason: Proof validity depends on the logical form of a derivation, not on motion or spatial change. A static proof ladder keeps every step inspectable, comparable and re-readable, while animation would serialize the steps and hide earlier ones. The required reorder/reveal interaction is a card-sort and fold-to-reveal activity, not an animation, and the stated accessibility preference is text plus a static proof tree.
staticAlternative: A two-column proof ladder on paper or a static HTML card: assumption, algebraic consequences, the parity contradiction, and the conclusion, with the contradiction step behind a fold-to-reveal card.
